description: A single-pole electronic relay module (transistor-driven) — IN is a logic-level signal from the microcontroller, switching a separate NC/COM/NO circuit.
how_to_use: VCC/GND power, IN is the digital control signal from the microcontroller. COM is the common switched contact; with the default NPN transistor, driving IN high connects COM to NO (and low/disconnected leaves it on NC) — a PNP-transistor variant reverses this. COM/NC/NO are the switched-circuit side, electrically isolated from VCC/GND/IN.
